import pyautogui, time

pyautogui.click(1150, 190)

import pyautogui, time
# Open Go to Line, jump to line 2
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'g')
time.sleep(0.3)
pyautogui.typewrite('2')
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.3)
# Select down through line 10 (8 more lines)
for _ in range(8):
    pyautogui.hotkey('shift', 'down')
    time.sleep(0.1)
# Indent selection
pyautogui.press('tab')
time.sleep(0.3)

import pyautogui, time
# Save the file
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's')
time.sleep(0.5)
